en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wide rural landscape with open fields in the foreground and a village in the distance. The village includes a church with a steeple and several low industrial buildings with tall chimneys. A simple printed border frames the image at the top, and there is a large blank area at the bottom with printed red text indicating a greeting from St. Peter near Graz, along with the publisher's name.
